content: {"episode_id":"ep-05159","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"Blue Summit Plan denied CPT 93271 for cardiac event monitoring under reason code PR-204 as not covered under the member's current benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents a patient with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats, prompting further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia, consistent with diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2. The cardiac event monitoring study was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances by capturing electrocardiographic data during symptom onset. We therefore submit this written appeal detailing the clinical necessity of CPT 93271 and request reconsideration of the PR-204 determination."}
